_meta.note: Standard Pokemon GO medal set with tier thresholds. Cross-referenced against Bulbapedia's Medal (GO) article and List of medals (GO) table (two independently-maintained pages that agreed on every threshold except Backpacker's Bronze tier), plus a targeted Dexerto article for the Ace Trainer Platinum threshold (which neither Bulbapedia page listed). Type-medal set and thresholds additionally cross-checked against Dexerto's general medals rundown.
sources: https://yetimoose.io/poke/medals/ (referenced per task brief; page is a client-rendered planner tool and did not expose raw threshold data to fetch)

onyxTier.explanation: The task brief asked to include an Onyx tier where it applies. Every source checked (both Bulbapedia medal pages, Dexerto's medal rundown, Pokemon GO Hub, and general web search covering the July-2026-current level-cap-80 update) describes medals as having exactly four tiers -- Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum -- with no Onyx tier documented anywhere, including in coverage of the Oct 2025 level 50->80 cap increase (which raised the *number* of Platinum medals required, not tier count). No medal below includes an 'onyx' key as a result -- adding one with a guessed number would violate the 'never fabricate' rule. The tiers object shape supports an optional onyx field (see medaldexEngine.js) so real data can be dropped in later with zero code changes if Niantic does add one.

medals.name: Battle Girl
medals.note: Gym battles won.

medals.name: Champion
medals.note: Raids won. Raid frequency is gated by pass economy (1 free Raid Pass/day baseline from spinning a Gym Photo Disc; Premium/Remote passes purchasable without a hard daily cap) rather than a fixed daily number, so no dailyCap is set.

medals.name: Battle Legend
medals.note: Legendary raids won. Same raid-pass-economy gating as Champion -- no fixed dailyCap.

medals.name: Rising Star
medals.note: Different species defeated in raids.

medals.name: Rising Star Duo
medals.note: Raids won with a friend.

medals.name: Ace Trainer
medals.note: Trainer Battles fought. Likely overlaps with the GO Battle League daily battle cap but Niantic's exact scope for this medal (GBL-only vs. all trainer battles) isn't confirmed, so dailyCap is left null rather than guessed.

medals.name: Great League Veteran
medals.note: Great League Trainer Battles won. GO Battle League battle cap: 10 sets x 5 battles/day (raised from 5 sets in the 2026 'Forever Forward' update). Actual wins will be lower than 50/day depending on win rate.

medals.name: Ultra League Veteran
medals.note: Ultra League Trainer Battles won. Same GO Battle League 50-battle/day cap as Great League Veteran.

medals.name: Master League Veteran
medals.note: Master League Trainer Battles won. Same GO Battle League 50-battle/day cap as Great League Veteran.

medals.name: Showcase Star
medals.note: PokeStop Showcases won.

medals.name: Hero
medals.note: Team GO Rocket members defeated.

medals.name: Ultra Hero
medals.note: Giovanni defeated.

medals.name: Purifier
medals.note: Shadow Pokemon purified.

medals.name: Idol
medals.note: Best Friends reached.

medals.name: Gentleman
medals.note: Pokemon traded. Standard-trade daily cap is 100 trades/account/day (Special Trades -- legendary/shiny/lucky/purified/undexed -- are capped separately at 1/day, occasionally 2 during events, and don't count toward this limit).

medals.name: Pilot
medals.note: Cumulative km distance across all trades. Indirectly bounded by the 100 trades/day cap and how far apart you and your trade partners are -- there's no fixed per-day km figure, so dailyCap is left null.

medals.name: Friend Finder
medals.note: Trainers referred.

medals.name: Community Member
medals.note: Check in with Community Ambassadors during Campfire-hosted events. Event-gated, not a daily mechanic -- most days offer zero opportunities toward this medal.

medals.name: Life of the Party
medals.note: Party Play challenges completed.

medals.name: Best Buddy
medals.note: Best Buddies achieved.

medals.name: Jogger
medals.note: Distance walked.

medals.name: Scientist
medals.note: Pokemon evolved.

medals.name: Breeder
medals.note: Eggs hatched.

medals.name: Backpacker
medals.note: Total PokeStops visited (spins). NOTE: one secondary source listed the Bronze threshold as 100 instead of 10 -- flagged unconfirmed pending a third source.

medals.name: Sightseer
medals.note: Unique PokeStops visited.

medals.name: Berry Master
medals.note: Berries fed at Gyms.

medals.name: Gym Leader
medals.note: Cumulative hours defending Gyms. Derived from calendar math (24h/day) assuming a Gym is held continuously without being knocked off -- not a Niantic-published number, just the physical ceiling.

medals.name: Pokemon Ranger
medals.note: Field Research tasks completed.

medals.name: Cameraman
medals.note: Surprise encounters in GO Snapshot.

medals.name: Wayfarer
medals.note: Wayfarer Agreements earned.

medals.name: Triathlete
medals.note: 7-day catch-streak or spin-streak achieved this many times. Periodic (weekly), not daily -- a streak completion lands at most once every 7 days per streak type, so the dailyCap/minDays model doesn't apply cleanly. Left null.

medals.name: Expert Navigator
medals.note: Routes completed. Niantic has stated there's no daily limit on Route completions themselves (only on certain Route rewards, like Zygarde Cells), so dailyCap is left null rather than invented.

medals.name: Raid Expert
medals.note: Raid Battle Trainer Achievements screen viewed.

medals.name: Successor
medals.note: Mega Evolutions performed (any species).

medals.name: Mega Evolution Guru
medals.note: Different species Mega Evolved.

medals.name: Picnicker
medals.note: Helped another Trainer catch Pokemon via your Lure Module.
